English: Hm? You mean the Time Shade? I’ve already defeated this stage’s boss—of course I have it.
Chinese: 嗯？你说时光之影？我已经干掉这关的BOSS了，当然在我手上。

English: If you want it… then you have to take it!
Chinese: 如果你想要……那就自己来拿吧！

English: Star Killer… This is the power of a version of me from a parallel world.
Chinese: 「斩星官」……这就是某个平行世界的我的力量。

English: If you can’t even surpass me, you’ll never defeat the bosses that lie ahead.
Chinese: 如果连我都无法跨越的话，是无法击败之后的BOSS的。

English: A trial… is about overcoming your past, weaker self! Come at me, Lucy!
Chinese: 所谓「试炼」……就是战胜过去不成熟的自己！来吧，露西！
